description: Complete redesign of BAT3 Validation Dashboard UI
objectives: Create modern Validation Dashboard with 6 tabs (Overview, Queue, Workers, Batches, Failure Analysis, Activity Log)
Implement real-time updates using polling and SSE
Build responsive Material-UI components with green theme
Add filterable/sortable tables for queue and workers
Implement bulk actions for queue management
Add worker monitoring and scaling controls
deliverables: web/src/Pages/ValidationDashboard.tsx - Main dashboard container with tabs
validation/api/main.py - Add batch list endpoint if needed
constraints: Follow existing component patterns in web/src/Components/
Use TypeScript for all new files
Implement proper error handling and loading states
Use existing API endpoints where available
parallel_opportunities: StatsCards component can be built independently
QueueTable can be built in parallel with WorkerList
BatchTable can be built in parallel with other components
Main dashboard layout can be created while components are being built
